name: INSAR 2027 Annual Meeting (International Society for Autism Research)
description: The INSAR 2027 Annual Meeting is planned for May 18 to 21, 2027 in Cape Town, the first INSAR meeting on the African continent. Accepted panels, oral presentations and posters must be presented in person and there is no late breaking abstract round.
